text:
Tessa (sales): Quick heads-up — Prospect 'FinTrack' wants EU-only residency for the POC, but also asks for APAC failover. BYOK KMS required. Can infra confirm subproc inventory for eu-west1 + asia-southeast1 and give a hosted vs dedicated cost delta for ~100 req/s? Need answer EOD.

Alex T.: We can support EU primary + APAC failover. Initial subproc list: GCP (compute/storage), Datadog (monitoring), Sentry (errors). I'll validate with infra for any additional vendors.

Maria S.: Confirming Datadog + GCP + Sentry. Note: if customer insists on BYOK (customer-managed KMS) for keys in our stack, that pushes to Dedicated or Private deployment for secure key peering — hosted has limits around persistent key trust.

Legal-Jane: I can draft the subprocessor attestation and DPA appendix. Also need to confirm no cross-border replication to non-EU/approved regions (e.g., do not touch mainland China).

Kevin R.: Rough pricing delta (quick ballpark): Dedicated reserved pool (guaranteed 100 req/s, low p95 latency) -> ~+35% vs baseline hosted. Hosted with caching & fallback -> ~15–20% cheaper but BYOK not fully supported. I'll run numbers in the pricing sheet and share link. https://redwood.example.com/pricing/poc-estimates

ops-oncall-bot: Runbook: region failover + tenant pinning: https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/region-failover

Alex T.: Sample routing policy we usually propose for this pattern:
```
route_policy:
  primary_region: eu-west1
  failover_regions: [asia-southeast1]
  allowed_subprocessors: [gcp, datadog, sentry]
  kms_mode: customer_managed  # BYOK requires dedicated/private with key peering
```

Kevin R.: Notes to reduce POC cost: enable prefix/KV caching, short TTLs, and batching (64-token batches) during the POC window — often cuts token cost by 30% in practice.

Tessa (sales): Action items: Alex to confirm final subproc inventory (by 16:00 UTC), Maria to confirm BYOK feasibility on hosted vs dedicated (by 15:00 UTC), Kevin to update cost delta and include maintenance window note (EOD), Legal to prepare DPA attestation template (tomorrow).

Alex T.: On it. Also flagging IP allowlist and TLS cert peering requirements if they want direct network paths.

Maria S.: Heads-up — there is a cert rotation maintenance window next Tue 02:00–04:00 UTC; if POC overlaps we'll need to schedule.

Kevin R.: +1, will add maintenance window to the quote and adjust SLA language.

Tessa (sales): Great — I'll compile answers for the customer and propose a call tomorrow AM. Thanks all :thumbsup:
